purpose: Classify every canonical owner teaching unit as activated, blocked, or contextual and bind it to explicit graph domains, live capabilities, or missing primitives without granting execution authority.

semantics.activated: At least one concrete production primitive already operationalizes a material part of the teaching. Activation may be partial and must name its source-backed target.
semantics.blocked: The teaching is operationalizable in principle, but an explicit source, metric, collector, state primitive, or mechanism is missing. The blocker becomes ranked architecture demand rather than a hidden island.
semantics.contextual: The teaching is intentionally reasoning context, preference, philosophy, or non-hard heuristic. It should influence interpretation where relevant but must not be converted into an automatic rule merely to improve activation rate.
semantics.activationRate: activated teaching units divided by all canonical owner teaching units. Partial activation still counts as activated but remains visibly marked partial.
semantics.noVanityPromotion: A teaching unit must never be marked activated merely because Ask can quote it or because a graph edge exists. A concrete production primitive is required.
